title: Binding mechanism of the DOPA-deficient mussel foot protein dbfp7 on rutile TiO2(110): an all-atom molecular dynamics study.
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD和伞形采样研究贻贝足蛋白dbfp7在TiO2表面的结合机制，虽非TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-表面界面动态结合建模方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
abstract: Protein adhesion to titanium dioxide surface underlies both biological implants and mussel based wet adhesives and is commonly attributed to the post translationally modified catechol bearing wild amino acid 2,3-dihydroxyphenylalanine. However, how the DOPA deficient protein dbfp7 adheres to the surface remains unclear. Using all atom molecular dynamics and umbrella sampling, we studied the mussel foot protein dbfp7, both short sequence-motif peptides and the intact N-terminal fragment across multiple conformers and orientations using rutile titanium oxide surface (110). Individual residues bind only weakly (at or below thermal energy) to the surface and binding did not strengthen with peptide length. Nonetheless, the intact protein fragment adheres irreversibly to the surface, engaging with multiple different interfaces rather than a single binding site. Aromatic residues were enriched at the interface when exposed to the surface but were not required, as an aromatic-poor face also binds equally well. These findings suggest that dbfp7 adheres to the surface through the collective action of many weak, non-specific contacts, providing a mechanism for robust adhesion in the absence of catechol chemistry.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质在二氧化钛表面的粘附是生物植入物和基于贻贝的湿粘合剂的基础，通常归因于翻译后修饰的含有儿茶酚的野生氨基酸2,3-二羟基苯丙氨酸。然而，缺乏DOPA的蛋白质dbfp7如何粘附于表面仍不清楚。利用全原子分子动力学和伞形采样，我们研究了贻贝足蛋白dbfp7，包括短序列基序肽和完整的N端片段，在多种构象和取向下，使用金红石型二氧化钛表面(110)。单个残基仅弱结合（在热能或低于热能水平）于表面，且结合强度不随肽段长度增加而增强。尽管如此，完整的蛋白质片段不可逆地粘附于表面，涉及多个不同界面而非单一结合位点。芳香族残基在暴露于表面时富集于界面，但并非必需，因为缺乏芳香族的表面也能同样良好地结合。这些发现表明，dbfp7通过许多弱非特异性接触的协同作用粘附于表面，为在缺乏儿茶酚化学的情况下实现稳健粘附提供了一种机制。
